name: Default
shortDescription: AI companion for Paperless-ngx that titles, tags and files documents, runs local OCR and answers questions about your archive.

alerts.message: The setup wizard is open to anyone who reaches the site until the first account is created. Complete it right after deployment.

Requires a reachable Paperless-ngx instance with an API token for a user that can view and change documents, plus an AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Azure or an OpenAI-compatible API) and its API key.
